source: Design tokens adapted from github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md, which analyses public brand websites.
usage: Read this only when the user chose 'Match a company' at intake. Shortlist two or three, then read design/brands.md for the translation rules. Render three title-slide previews and let the user pick by looking.
honesty: These are website design systems, not slide templates. Read design/brands.md before using one. Palette, type pairing, radius and spacing transfer. Buttons, navigation and breakpoints do not.
Describe the result as 'in the spirit of <company>', never as official or as being from that company.
Never reproduce a company logo or wordmark in a deck that is not theirs.
Most brand fonts are proprietary. brands.md gives the substitution chain.
A company not listed anywhere here still works. Build the palette from its publicly documented brand colours, follow design/brands.md, and say plainly at delivery that this is what you did.

curated.name: Linear
curated.best_for: Product and engineering decks. Near-black ground, violet accent, very tight type. Big numbers land hard.
curated.avoid_for: Printed decks and bad projectors.

curated.name: Vercel
curated.best_for: Technical decks that want nothing decorative. Pure monochrome, geometry does all the work.
curated.avoid_for: Anything needing warmth or colour coding.

curated.name: Stripe
curated.best_for: Fintech, B2B and developer-facing decks. Deep navy text on white with a confident violet.
curated.avoid_for: Creative and campaign work. Too corporate.

curated.name: Notion
curated.best_for: Teaching, documentation and internal decks. Reads like a well-set document.
curated.avoid_for: Decks that need to persuade hard.

curated.name: Claude
curated.best_for: Research, thought leadership and anything that should feel human. Cream ground with a warm coral, deliberately warm where most tech is cool.
curated.avoid_for: Hard financial material where warmth undercuts the message.

curated.name: Apple
curated.best_for: Product launches and demos. Enormous type, huge white space, one image doing the work.
curated.avoid_for: Dense analysis. The system refuses density.

curated.name: IBM
curated.best_for: Enterprise, research and consulting. A strict grid and IBM Plex carry dense information calmly.
curated.avoid_for: Warm or emotional work. It reads as engineered.

curated.name: Figma
curated.best_for: Design reviews, creative work, workshops. Multi-colour accents on white.
curated.avoid_for: Sober financial or legal material.

curated.name: Airbnb
curated.best_for: Consumer and brand decks built around photography. Rounded, generous, approachable.
curated.avoid_for: Decks with no images. The system leans on them.

curated.name: Wise
curated.best_for: Fintech and consumer finance. Acid green against near-black, unusually confident for the category.
curated.avoid_for: Traditional or conservative finance audiences.

curated.name: Revolut
curated.best_for: Fintech pitches and product launches on a good screen.
curated.avoid_for: Print and projectors.

curated.name: Slack
curated.best_for: Internal comms, onboarding, team decks. Deep aubergine with bright secondary colours.
curated.avoid_for: Formal external deliverables.

curated.name: Shopify
curated.best_for: Commerce, retail and merchant-facing decks. Plain and businesslike.
curated.avoid_for: Work that needs a distinctive visual signature.

curated.name: WIRED
curated.best_for: Conference talks and opinion-led decks. Magazine structure, heavy rules, one hot accent.
curated.avoid_for: Chart-heavy analysis. The restraint fights dense data.

curated.name: MongoDB
curated.best_for: Developer and data decks. Deep slate text with a bright green that survives a projector.
curated.avoid_for: Consumer brand work.

curated.name: Raycast
curated.best_for: Developer tools and demos. Near-black with a coral accent and precise type.
curated.avoid_for: Print, and any room with a weak projector.

curated.name: Nike
curated.best_for: Campaign and brand work. Enormous condensed type, full-bleed imagery, almost no body copy.
curated.avoid_for: Anything with real information density.

curated.name: Uber
curated.best_for: Consumer, transport, logistics and operations decks. Pure black on white with heavy type. Reads as practical rather than decorative.
curated.avoid_for: Work needing warmth or colour coding.

curated.name: Mastercard
curated.best_for: Payments, banking and enterprise decks. A warm cream ground rather than white, which is easier to read for long stretches and prints well.
curated.avoid_for: Startup pitches. It reads institutional.

curated.name: BMW
curated.best_for: Automotive, manufacturing, industrial and premium product decks. Confident blue against near-black, built around large photography.
curated.avoid_for: Decks with no imagery. The system leans on it.

also_available_by_name.note: Not curated because their systems lean on photography, licensed typefaces or product UI that does not translate to slides. Usable if the user asks for one by name. Fetch its DESIGN.md from the source repo, then apply design/brands.md as normal, and tell the user which parts did not translate.
